title: OpenAI, Microsoft agree to cap revenue-sharing at $38 billion, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，OpenAI 与微软同意将收入分成上限限制在 380 亿美元
summary: OpenAI and Microsoft  agreed to cap total revenue-sharing payments at $38 billion, U.S. ‌digital news outlet The Information reported ‌on Monday, citing a person with knowledge of the arrangement.
summary_zh: 美国数字新闻媒体 The Information 周一援引一位知情人士的话报道称，OpenAI 和微软同意将收入分成总额上限限制在 380 亿美元。

title: Tesla's Elon Musk, Apple's Tim Cook among CEOs set to join Trump on China trip
title_zh: 特斯拉的埃隆·马斯克、苹果的蒂姆·库克等首席执行官将与特朗普一起进行中国之行

summary_zh: 本周，预计 16 名企业高管将与特朗普总统一起出访，与中国领导人习近平会面。

title: Musk, Cook Expected to Join Trump for Xi Summit in China
title_zh: 马斯克、库克预计将与特朗普一起出席中国习近平峰会
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The White House is inviting Tesla Inc.’s Elon Musk, Apple Inc.’s Tim Cook, Boeing Co.’s Kelly Ortberg and executives from other large companies to accompany President Donald Trump on his trip to China this week, according to an official.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——据一位官员透露，白宫正在邀请特斯拉公司的埃隆·马斯克、苹果公司的蒂姆·库克、波音公司的凯利·奥特伯格以及其他大公司的高管本周陪同唐纳德·特朗普总统访华。

title: Meta Sued by California County Over ‘Scam’ Advertisements
title_zh: Meta 因“诈骗”广告被加州县起诉
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc. was sued by Santa Clara County, California, over allegations that the company “knowingly facilitates and profits from billions of scam advertisements” on its social networks, including Facebook and Instagram.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Meta Platforms Inc. 被加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉县起诉，指控该公司在其社交网络（包括 Facebook 和 Instagram）上“故意促进数十亿诈骗广告并从中获利”。

title: Wall Street says stock market euphoria has echoes of 1999, but a firmer foundation
